name: Ocal Browser v9.8.9 (Stable)
body:
## 🚀 Ocal Browser v9.8.9 (Stable) — Release Notes

### 🛡️ Site Data & Cookie Eraser
* **Comprehensive Partition Purging**: Completely deletes persistent cookies, local storage, cache, and IndexedDB across all active profile partitions and network sessions.
* **Subdomain & Base Domain Sweep**: Thoroughly wipes domain-level cookies (`.youtube.com`, `www.youtube.com`, etc.) down to 0 bytes.
* **Active Tab Loop Disconnect**: Halts background network loops and socket pings on matching tabs during deletion to prevent immediate cookie regeneration.

### 📦 Dual-Format Certified Packaging
* **Inno Setup Standalone Installer**: Standalone setup executable signed with Authenticode SHA-256 and RFC 3161 timestamping.
* **Microsoft Store MSIX Package**: Full AppX/MSIX package signed with digital certificate and automated cert deployment.

### 🎨 UI & Engine Stability
* **Updated What's New & Settings**: Synchronized release version badges, system status indicators, and permission reset controls.
